 Petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying that in
the circumstances stated in the affidavit filed therewith, the High Court
may be pleased to it an appropriate Writ, Order or Direction d. more
particularly one in the nature of Writ of Mandamus, declaring the action of
the respondents in not in seeking to Acquit land and structures covered
by D.No.7/1390-3, 7/1391, 7/1390-2, 7/13100-1, 7/1389, and 7/1390 of
the petitioners respectively situated abutting to Korrapadu Road,
Proddutur, Kadapa District, A.P. for the purpose of widening of the
existing road from 60 Feet to 100 Ft. without initiating proceedings under
the land Acquisition Act and without paying compensation, as illegal,
arbitrary and violative of Article 300-A of the Constitution of India and
consequently direct the respondents not to acquire the lands and
structure of the petitioners covered by premises bearing D.No.7/1390-3,
7/1391, 7/1390-2, 7/1390-1, 7/1389, and 7/1390 abutting to Korrapadu
Road, Proddutur, Kadapa District, A.P. without paying compensation to
the petitioners, and to pass such other order orders as this Hon'ble Court
may deem fit and proper in the circumstances of the case.
